runner.source:
import subprocess, pathlib, json, hashlib, time, os, shlex
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/sirkit_epq_413713/validation')
source=root/'active_path.cpp'
baseline=root/'baseline9ec.hpp'
assert hashlib.sha256(baseline.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='9ec6f14de6fb405f226328d42d1f16e6ed1a98005094caf3924a27f39b177fe6'
records=[]
(root/'environment.txt').write_text(subprocess.check_output(['/usr/bin/g++-15','--version'],text=True)+subprocess.check_output(['/usr/bin/clang++-21','--version'],text=True)+subprocess.check_output(['uname','-a'],text=True)+subprocess.check_output(['lscpu'],text=True))
(root/'hashes.json').write_text(json.dumps({str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [source,baseline]},indent=2))
for compiler in ['gcc15_2','clang21']:
 for checks in ['checked','skip']:
  for mode in ['default','standard','asan_ubsan']:
   name=f'{compiler}_{checks}_{mode}'
   binary=root/name
   cxx=['/usr/bin/g++-15'] if compiler=='gcc15_2' else ['/usr/bin/clang++-21','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15']
   flags=['-std=c++23','-Wall','-Wextra','-pedantic','-g','-MMD','-MF',str(root/(name+'.d')),f'-DEPQ_SOURCE="{baseline}"']
   flags+=['-O1','-fsanitize=address,undefined','-fno-omit-frame-pointer'] if mode=='asan_ubsan' else ['-O2']
   if mode=='standard': flags+=['-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD']
   if checks=='skip': flags+=['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
   command=['taskset','-c','10']+cxx+flags+[str(source),'-o',str(binary)]
   record={'name':name,'compile_command':shlex.join(command),'start':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')}
   start=time.monotonic()
   try:
    run=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=150)
    record.update(compile_returncode=run.returncode,compile_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
    (root/(name+'.compile.log')).write_text(run.stdout+run.stderr)
    if run.returncode==0:
     dep=(root/(name+'.d')).read_text(); record['frozen_include_verified']=str(baseline) in dep
     record['binary_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
     (root/(name+'.comment.txt')).write_text(subprocess.check_output(['readelf','-p','.comment',str(binary)],text=True))
     env=os.environ.copy();env['ASAN_OPTIONS']='detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1';env['UBSAN_OPTIONS']='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1'
     command=['taskset','-c','2',str(binary)]
     record['run_command']=shlex.join(command);record['ASAN_OPTIONS']=env['ASAN_OPTIONS'];record['UBSAN_OPTIONS']=env['UBSAN_OPTIONS']
     start=time.monotonic();run=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=120)
     record.update(run_returncode=run.returncode,run_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,stdout=run.stdout,stderr=run.stderr)
     (root/(name+'.run.log')).write_text(run.stdout+run.stderr)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as ex:
    record['timeout']=str(ex)
   records.append(record)
   (root/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
   print(name, 'compile',record.get('compile_returncode'), 'run',record.get('run_returncode'), record.get('stdout','').strip(), flush=True)

report:
# Baseline boundary harness verification, 2026-10-28

Baseline SHA-256: `9ec6f14de6fb405f226328d42d1f16e6ed1a98005094caf3924a27f39b177fe6`
Standalone active_path.cpp SHA-256: `bef03a5a9bc251bc9c4ad6fc7220315d469311fdd8e50edc02c069a72c96d156`

Baseline9ec only was run. No prefetch candidate was executed or validated by this task. No repository changes were made. The standalone source uses EPQ_SOURCE to choose a header; its default is the adjacent frozen baseline9ec.hpp.

All 12 baseline configurations passed: GCC15.2 and Clang21.1.8, checked/skip × -O2 default/SIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD/-O1 ASan+UBSan, all in standard C++23. Every run reports 5,959,132 assertions, 2,116,344 pop/extract operations and 52 cases. Default and SIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD binaries are byte-identical per compiler/check setting. Build logs and stderr are empty. Every depfile names baseline9ec.hpp; readelf .comment confirms GCC15.2/Clang21.1.8. Builds use CPU10 and functional runs CPU2. Durations are functional-test records, not performance evidence.

Types and order: int64_t and uint64_t, each min/max. Threshold cases n=262143..262149 and 262159..262161 cover all four child-count remainders and the pop-after-removal threshold. Construction alternates moved-vector heapification with repeated push. Values alternate permutation with signed/unsigned extrema, duplicate values with extrema, and all equal. Each ordinary case pops down to 262128 remaining elements; cases starting above the threshold cross it. Representative n=262146 (permuted values/vector build) and n=262147 (duplicates/repeated push) fully drain. A separately sorted vector supplies the expected order; pop/extract_top/top/try_top/size/empty/clear/reuse are checked.

Lazy/ownership cases n=262401 cover all three value patterns. Seventeen first/interior values are erased without normalizing. std::multiset supplies the independent expected sequence. Copy construction, copy assignment, move construction, move assignment and swap preserve the pending state; three owners each pop 512 times across the threshold. Moved-from objects are reused, clearing one owner leaves other owners intact, and clear/empty are checked.

ASan/UBSan settings: ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1; UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1. No diagnostics. LeakSanitizer was not run.

All actual compile/run commands, binary hashes, return codes, output and times are in results.json. Source/header hashes are in hashes.json; environment.txt records host/compiler metadata. Per-configuration .d, .comment.txt, .compile.log and .run.log files preserve the evidence.
